name: io.github.Pantheon-Security/technitium-mcp-secure
description: MCP server for Technitium DNS Server management and diagnostics

environmentVariables.name: TECHNITIUM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Technitium DNS admin API (e.g. https://192.168.1.100:5380)

environmentVariables.name: TECHNITIUM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token for authentication (use this or TECHNITIUM_PASSWORD)

environmentVariables.name: TECHNITIUM_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the API token (0600 perms recommended)

environmentVariables.name: TECHNITIUM_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Admin password (used to obtain a session token if no token is set)

environmentVariables.name: TECHNITIUM_USER
environmentVariables.description: Admin username for password auth (default: admin)

environmentVariables.name: TECHNITIUM_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose only read-only tools

environmentVariables.name: TECHNITIUM_ALLOW_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to permit a plaintext http:// URL (lab use only)
